messages:
Aisha (CS): Hey team — day-of runbook for tomorrow's enablement (09:00 PT / 17:00 BST). Putting together a short hosting roster + materials checklist. Who can own live hosting vs. hands-on lab facilitation?
Matt (Enablement): I can take live hosting for the first 40m. Happy to hand off to Ravi for the lab.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Yep I can do the lab and be backup for Q&A. Will bring the quick troubleshooting slides.
Lina (Customer Ops): I'll own pre-read distribution and the feedback form. I posted the Typeform link in the agenda thread yesterday.
Aisha (CS): Awesome. We need a backup host in-case Matt's laptop acts up — Ravi confirmed as backup. Can someone volunteer to monitor chat and raise escalations?
Jo (Observer): I can monitor chat and capture real-time asks in a shared doc.
Matt (Enablement): @Jo thanks. Can you also drop quick snippets into the running notes (section: blockers & follow-ups)?
Jo (Observer): Will do.
runbook-bot: Checklist reminder: 1) Slides uploaded to shared drive 24h prior 2) Demo env checked 1h prior 3) Recording link ready 4) Breakout rooms pre-created.
Aisha (CS): Quick status: Slides are on Drive (v1.3) — Matt please confirm final pass by EOD. Demo env: Ravi, ping when you finish smoke tests.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Smoke tests pass on the staging build. One flakey step around model boot — workaround in notes.
Matt (Enablement): I'll do a final pass at 18:00 PT and push updates to the slide deck.
Lina (Customer Ops): Feedback capture plan: short Typeform (3 q's) + optional free text. We'll trigger follow-up if NPS-style rating <= 6. I'll draft follow-up template.
Aisha (CS): Good. Also let's plan the run order and timings in-case we need to trim: 09:00 intro, 09:10 demo, 09:25 lab, 09:50 Q&A, 10:00 wrap. Keep each section strict.
Matt (Enablement): Suggestion: put a 2-min checkpoint at 09:45 to decide whether to extend Q&A or cut lab.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Agree. Also: for the lab, add pre-created sample dataset so attendees can get started in <5m.
Lina (Customer Ops): I'll email registered contacts the pre-read + sample dataset link 12h prior. Also asking legal for the recording consent checkbox — awaiting reply.
Aisha (CS): If legal can't confirm, we'll mark recording as optional and prompt attendees at start.
Matt (Enablement): Small ops note: breakout rooms will be by workspace; facilitators are Ravi and Jo. Assignments in the runbook.
Jo (Observer): I'll handle breakout room join messages and surface hands raised.
Lina (Customer Ops): Post-event: I'll send the Typeform 15 minutes after close and tag follow-ups in SFDC with the outcome.
Aisha (CS): One last ask — can someone own the 'post-mortem + improvement bullets' doc? We want 3 quick fixes by EOD tomorrow.
Matt (Enablement): I can draft the post-mortem skeleton; Lina can add CS ops follow-ups.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll add technical action items (demo reliability / model boot).
Aisha (CS): Perfect. Thanks everyone — leaving this thread pinned so people can reference the runbook links. :sparkles:
Matt (Enablement): :thumbsup:
Jo (Observer): Done — pinned and added the recording placeholder in notes.
runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://drive.company/redwood/enablement/runbooks/day-of-1713501234-v1 (check access)
Lina (Customer Ops): Also adding the post-session survey link here: https://typeform.com/to/xyz123
Aisha (CS): Great. If anything blocks, ping here or DM. See you all at the dry run 1h before the session.
Matt (Enablement): Dry run meeting invite sent for 08:00 PT.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Got it.
Jo (Observer): I'll be there to rehearse notes flow.
Lina (Customer Ops): I'll verify the survey logic in the form before dry run.
Aisha (CS): Nice — closing out.
